# Sandworm's Destructive Attack Patterns

Sandworm (also tracked as Voodoo Bear, Seashell Blizzard, IRIDIUM; attributed to Russia's GRU Unit 74455) is arguably the most operationally destructive state-sponsored actor ever documented. Their patterns are well established in public threat intelligence (CISA, MITRE ATT&CK group ID G0034, ESET, Mandiant).

## Signature Campaigns

**BlackEnergy / KillDisk — Ukrainian power grid (Dec 2015)**
- Spear-phishing with malicious Office macros delivered BlackEnergy 3
- Attackers spent months on SCADA networks, then manually opened breakers via legitimate HMI access
- Deployed KillDisk to wipe Windows workstations/servers *after* the outage to delay restoration
- Flashed serial-to-Ethernet converters with malicious firmware to brick remote recovery
- Telephone denial-of-service against utility call centers to suppress customer reports
